# Territorium Capital

Territorium Capital is a territorial intelligence and natural capital firm based in Spain. It helps owners, investors, family offices, companies and public administrations understand, restore, buy, sell and manage territories with ecological value.

Core thesis: biodiversity increases territorial resilience; resilience reduces climate risk and supports ecological, patrimonial and financial value.

Primary services:
- Buying or selling territories with high ecological value: https://territorium.capital/comprar-vender-territorio-alto-valor-ecologico/
- Turnkey ecological restoration: https://territorium.capital/restauracion-ecologica-llave-en-mano/
- Ecological value diagnosis for territories: https://territorium.capital/valor-ecologico-territorio/
- Territorial services: https://territorium.capital/servicios/
- Vision and methodology: https://territorium.capital/vision/
- Why Territorium: https://territorium.capital/por-que-nosotros/

Important concepts:
- Natural capital
- Ecological value
- Biodiversity
- Climate resilience
- Territorial asset
- Turnkey ecological restoration
- High ecological value territory
- Financial territorial intelligence
